title: Required Documents
subtitle: Essential paperwork for your visa application

personal.title: Personal Documents
personal.description: Passport with at least 6 months validity, identity documents and paperwork containing your personal information.

education.title: Educational Documents
education.description: Diplomas, certificates and language proficiency documents. Apostille may be required for international recognition.

professional.title: Professional Documents
professional.description: Job offer letter, employment contract, professional qualification certificates and experience documents.

medical.title: Medical & Legal
medical.description: Medical report, criminal background check, financial status documents and your biometric photographs.

list: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity
